paragraphs.text: Kasla is an angel ally from Zendikar who fought in defense of the plane.
Kasla is an angel who was sworn to protect her home of Zendikar and its inhabitants. She acted as a shepherd of the goddess Emeria .
After shattering her halo in an act of heroism, she reforged its pieces into a deadly scythe. She fought in defense of Zendikar during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
